# Anycode v0.0.24

This release refactors layout resizing and scroll persistence, upgrades TypeScript and Dockview, integrates the Grok agent, and updates LSP documentation.

## TypeScript Upgrade

- Upgraded TypeScript to version `7.0.2` across the workspace projects (`anycode-base`, `anycode-react`, and root configurations).

## Layout & Scroll Persistence

- Refactored layout resizing and group boundaries.
- Upgraded `dockview` and `dockview-react` to version `7.0.2` for modern layout management and responsiveness.
- Implemented editor scroll position persistence (`usePersistedScroll`) to prevent layout/scroll resets when switching between files or panels.

## Grok Agent Integration

- Configured and integrated the new Grok agent into ACP (Agent Client Protocol) configurations.
- Added custom message layout and icon styling support for Grok agent communications.

## Documentation

- Relocated Language Server Protocol (LSP) docs to the `docs/` folder and resolved relative documentation links.
- Updated installation instructions for the dotnet LSP.

**Full comparison:** `v0.0.23...v0.0.24`
